"''Mmm, Arkie has the new flavors.|Cassian Andor and Windi|}} '''Arkie''' was an individual who ran a [[beach]]front [[Arkie's|store]] near several resorts on{{Andor|Announcement}} {{AD|Disney+}} the [[planet]]{{Databank|niamos|Niamos}} [[Niamos]]. In [[5 BBY]],{{AndorDate|107}} [[Windi]], a [[human]] who was staying in a nearby [[Niamos hotel|hotel]] with fellow human [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], asked Andor to visit Arkie's when he went out for a walk. When Andor said that he planned to go in the opposite direction, she informed him that Arkie had new flavors and requested that he also purchase [[Peezo]]s and [[Color|green]] [[Revnog]], as they were out of both. Andor agreed but was arrested by the [[Galactic Empire]] outside of Arkie's before he could enter. ==Behind the scenes== Arkie was mentioned in "[[Announcement]]," the seventh episode of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', which was released on [[October 19]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like.
